user.title: Add a charger
user.description: Find the charger through Tuya Cloud, or enter its local connection details.

cloud.title: Tuya Cloud
cloud.description: Enter the Access ID and Access Secret of your Tuya IoT project. The Smart Life account must be linked to that project.

data_description.access_id: Client ID of the Tuya IoT project.
data_description.access_secret: Client Secret of the Tuya IoT project.

cloud_device.title: Select the charger
cloud_device.description: Choose the device to add. Its local key is read from Tuya Cloud; the local IP is discovered on the LAN.

local.title: Local connection
local.description: The integration tests the connection and detects the Tuya protocol version before creating the entry.

data_description.host: Local IP address of the charger on the same network as Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the local key
reauth_confirm.description: The charger rejected the stored local key. Enter the new key.

reconfigure.title: Update the charger connection
reconfigure.description: Change the IP address, local key or protocol version.

host.title: Charger IP address
host.description: The charger was found in Tuya Cloud, but its local IP could not be discovered automatically. Enter its LAN IP address (for example 192.168.1.43), visible in your router's device list.

error.cloud_auth_failed: Tuya Cloud rejected the credentials or project permissions.
error.cloud_no_devices: No devices are linked to this Tuya project.
error.cloud_timeout: Tuya Cloud did not answer in time.
error.missing_config: IP address, device ID and local key are required.
error.invalid_auth: The charger rejected the local key.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the charger on the local network.
error.port_busy: Port 6668 is already used by another client. Close Smart Life or the Tuya app and retry.
error.unsupported_device: The device connected, but its Tuya profile is not supported yet.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while connecting to the charger.
